rationale: KDP gapped up ~2.35% on 4.57x relative volume but has since faded from the session high of $36.13 to $35.81, sitting below the 9-EMA ($35.86) and essentially at VWAP ($35.82), with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, low-momentum consolidation near the lower third of today's range.
